newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms on Central Bank dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms on Central Bank dlr sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly firmer at 469.50/470.50 per dollar Tuesday, compared to 469.75/471.00 per dollar Monday, as the Central bank sold foreign currency to defend the bolivar, dealers said.
"In the morning foreign currency sales dominated, but in the afternoon the market was more active as some big banks came in to buy," said one trader.
"The Central Bank immediately covered the demand and brought the exchange rate down," he added.

Traders said they expected renewed demand for foreign currency Wednesday in anticipation of a further drop in local interest rates following the Central Bank's weekly Monetary Stabilization, or TEM, bill auction.
